brain.commentary: Risk-on conditions are supported by the cross-asset regime and normal market state, but conviction is generally modest and crypto drawdown risk remains material. Apply a restrained 0.80 portfolio multiplier. Prefer BTC, LTC, LINK, and selectively UNI; UNI has the strongest signal but remains fragile because of very high volatility and weak liquidity. Fragile or cautionary signals include XRP, DOGE, ADA, AVAX, BCH, and ETC due to weak alpha, poor institutional/liquidity scores, or elevated expected shortfall.
